test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Hindustan Steel Limited (HSL) was initially designed to manage which of the following steel plants in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rourkela**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Steel Limited (HSL)** was created with the intention of managing only one new plant in **Rourkela**.
 
• The Iron and Steel Ministry did the groundwork for the Bhilai and Durgapur steel plants.
 
• Hindustan Steel was given administration and oversight of these two steel factories in April 1957. New Delhi was the company's first registered office.
 
• In July 1956, it relocated to Calcutta, and in December 1959, it moved to Ranchi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **SAIL **owns and runs five integrated steel mills, including those at** Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur, Bokaro, and Burnpur (Asansol),** as well as three special steel plants in Salem, Durgapur, and Bhadravathi.
 
• In Chandrapur, it also owns a Ferro Alloy facility. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Steel Authority of India Limited:**

 
 
• Founded: **24**** January 1973**
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi, India
 
• Chairman: Soma Mondal
